title: Chord spans as locators and the key as the set's scale
description:
## Intent

Chords as locators, and the set's scale.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/set.rs` (or `locators.rs`): one locator per `Timeline.harmony` span, at its `start_beat`, named with `ChordSpan.label`; none when the score has no progression.
- The set's scale from `Timeline.key`, if M0 found the target version has one (root and mode names mapped per `design/daw-set.md`); otherwise drop the scenario and note it there.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "Chords as locators" scenarios pass.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): chords as locators in the DAW set`. Not breaking.
